name: MedHallBench
description: MedHallBench is a benchmark framework designed to evaluate and mitigate hallucinations in medical large language models by integrating expert-validated medical case scenarios with established medical databases. It combines automated ACHMI scoring with clinical expert evaluations and reinforcement learning methods to provide a nuanced assessment of hallucinations in diverse clinical contexts.
reputation: A recent medical hallucination benchmark that is still early in adoption, but is relevant for evaluating safety-critical clinical LLM behavior.
notes: Uses a novel ACHMI metric and reinforcement learning from human feedback for automatic annotation.
